purpose: Acceptance contract for the immutable v1.94.0 release candidate. Publication and dual-host installation are post-commit effects and are verified separately to avoid a self-referential Git candidate.
sourceRequest: Publish the accepted Harness Engineering absorption, deploy it to WSL and Windows, and make the latest ITD methodology the default in every directory.

criteria.criterion: The v1.94.0 manifests, badges, current Harness documentation, dated changelog entry, and current internal pilot evidence are synchronized while all frozen Harness Demo guarantees remain unchanged.
criteria.source: User release request and frozen Harness Demo absorption contract.
criteria.evidence: The rolling candidate oracle invokes the self-contained portable Harness Demo proof, including the frozen 34 mutation guards, historical v4 fixture, and all non-host-local behavioral phases.

criteria.criterion: Host-adapter parity, meta-review, quick regression, and full regression pass on one exact candidate without vendor-specific methodology drift.
criteria.evidence: All four checks are required machine runs in the exact RLS-001 adjudication before commit.
criteria.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_host_adapters.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/meta_review.py && bash tests/run-all.sh --quick && bash tests/run-all.sh

criteria.criterion: The release keeps methodology-owned pilots externalAdoptionEvidence:false and leaves PE5-008/009 blocked pending real independent external outcomes.
criteria.evidence: The sealed portable pilot oracle binds all three exact index rows and their complete receipt/artifact graphs while rejecting any external-adoption claim.

postCommitVerification.criterion: The exact accepted commit is pushed and has one open PR to current main whose structured evidence block binds the exact tree, scope, and adjudication receipt.
The exact published tree is hash-identical in both Codex caches and both Claude active installs, and all four global routers select ITD by default without legacy Product Factory policy.

doneRule: The immutable candidate is accepted only when every criterion is passed and one current exact-candidate Verification Loop adjudication re-runs every named command. The user goal remains active until both post-commit verification commands also pass.
